name: Hao Xinyu
source:
She lives in a suburban villa. The only family she sees is Naomi. The enormous villa is even more empty.

Ophelia has already had an enviable job, which pays her handsomely, in an up-and-coming company as a luxury designer. She is not the most prolific designer though. Productivity could be a problem for her.
